warnings: Live-only: the stock game without the resident DLL ignores UncrashedMCP.collision; everyone else (and a game started without the agent) gets normal collision. Use non-colliding catalogue rows for stock-reliable scenery.

Which channel the drone / vehicles collide on is not verified: default Pawn+PhysicsBody+Vehicle. Run agent "collision channels" while flying and pass channels=[...] if the drone uses another object channel.
Object rules match catalogue row + pivot within 2 cm: moving an object detaches it from its rule (collision_state reports unmatched rules). Group rules survive moves.
flythrough keeps query collision (object type, Visibility, Camera), so traces, audits and editor picking still see the object; off removes it from every trace too.
